definitions: Workbook scope
79 pipeline intervals plus one literature-reported junction; all seven original comparison pairs retained.
Karyotype reference
Closest plausible intermediate structural reference used in the original pairwise comparison; not an assertion that an extant species was the direct ancestor.
Derived karyotype
Karyotype interpreted as derived relative to that paired reference. RAK is not substituted for the supplied intermediate.
Direction under paired model

For mixed fission/fusion pairs, Fission-associated boundary describes separation of a continuous paired reference interval into different query chromosomes. It is not a one-to-one elementary-event assignment.
Direction confidence

Conditional: paired intermediate = structural direction supported under the original paired-reference model; independent outgroup/phylogenetic confidence has not been reassessed. This is not a numerical probability.
Published; not reassessed
The original workbook cites this junction from Hofstatter et al. 2022. The current audit has not independently localized or polarized it.
Elementary event assignment
Unresolved: boundary-to-event mapping means the recorded transition has not been mapped uniquely to one of the original inferred fissions/fusions; do not count it as an independent fission.
Counts

Original 35 fissions + 34 fusions = 69 counts elementary transformations at pair level. Catalogue rows represent observed boundaries. The original Methods count N fissions for N+1 different query chromosomes within a target and count fusion only for terminal joining of broken target fragments; repeated fragments count once per target.
Pair count columns
Repeated on rows as context only. Do not sum these columns across junction rows. Pair_summary_source contains the original aggregate feature summary.
Reference and derived chromosome units

Numbers of chromosome units in the analysed representation; these are not always full biological haploid numbers in polyploids. R. austrobrasiliensis uses a three-chromosome pseudo-haplotype; R. gaudichaudii is polyploid.
Coordinate species
Species carrying the larger aligned chromosome used as coordinate target. Target/query orientation is independent of temporal direction.
Coordinates
Raw positions and source sizes are preserved. Normalized endpoints are min/max of the source endpoints. A reversed source interval is an overlap between flanking alignments, not a negative-size gap.
Source size
Original interval size is abs(end-start), without +1. Original aggregate summary means have been preserved and were not recalculated.
Legacy overlap convention

Rechecks treat supplied integer annotation intervals as closed, following the original GRanges scripts. Overlapping annotation records are merged before overlap bp is summed. The legacy tracks include directly extracted GFF/CSV coordinates, so overlap bp is explicitly labelled by this convention.
Endpoint sensitivity
The three formerly blank intervals were additionally tested with half-open overlap and ±1 bp boundary perturbations; their no-overlap calls are unchanged.
Tyba overlap

Yes/No for existing records is transcribed from the source annotation unless the assessment states a blank was resolved. Uncertain flags a conflict between source annotation and local track intersections. Unknown is used for the unlocalized literature junction. Reported negative annotations have not all been independently validated.
Feature classes
Copia and Gypsy are LTR retrotransposons. DNA transposons are separate. Telomere repeats are separate from TEs. Tyba-or-TE means Tyba, Copia, Gypsy or DNA transposon.
NA in three repaired cells
No overlap with Tyba, Copia, Gypsy, DNA-transposon, interstitial-telomere or terminal-telomere tracks at the supplied interval. This is not a missing value.
Feature evidence paths
Paths are relative to the Compare_20_Rhynchospora directory. For original annotations not recomputed, the workbook source cell is the evidence.
Feature reassessment scope

All 23 R. alba coordinate intervals were compared with local plot tracks. Only the three blank source cells were filled. Existing nonblank annotations and original summary values were preserved, with any discrepancies flagged.
Repeat association denominator

J080 has no verified coordinates and cannot enter interval overlap denominators. Direction-independent association can use an unresolved but assessable boundary; fusion-versus-fission event analyses need a justified event mapping.
Independence
Historical event groups have not been assigned. Do not equate 80 catalogue entries with 80 independent evolutionary events; WGD/shared ancestral events can replicate a junction.
Audit code
revision_junction_catalogue/analyse_junctions.py and update_workbook.mjs; original workbook backed up before editing.
